title: Quantitative PCR (qPCR / RT-qPCR)
summary: Real-time amplification with SYBR Green or TaqMan for quantitative gene-expression or copy-number measurements.

reagents.name: 2× SYBR Green or TaqMan master mix

hazardsMd: Standard low-risk reagents. Optical-clear seals must be flat — bubbles ruin reads.
contentUndergrad:
## Why qPCR
Real-time fluorescence measurement converts amplification into a Ct value, which (with a standard curve) gives copy number or relative expression. Always run technical triplicates.

steps.title: Design or validate primers
steps.instructionMd: Primers should give amplicons 70-150 bp with Tm 58-62 °C. For RT-qPCR, span an exon-exon junction to exclude gDNA contamination. Validate with a melt curve before quantitation.
steps.verificationMd: Primer3 / Benchling output saved with picked pair. Single peak in melt curve at the expected Tm.

steps.title: Prepare master mix on ice
steps.instructionMd: Per 10 μL reaction: 5 μL 2× mix + 0.4 μL each primer (10 μM) + 3.2 μL water + 1 μL template. Make for n+2 reactions; pipette template into each well last.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Run all samples in technical triplicate. Include NTC (no template control) and NRT (no reverse transcriptase control if RT-qPCR).
steps.verificationMd: Plate map filed in lab notebook. NTC and NRT wells marked clearly.

steps.title: Seal and centrifuge the plate
steps.instructionMd: Apply optical-clear adhesive seal. Use the seal applicator to remove every bubble. Spin at 1000×g for 1 min to drop any droplets to the well bottom.
steps.verificationMd: No visible bubbles at well bottoms. Seal lies flat (no warping).

steps.title: Run the cycler with melt curve
steps.verificationMd: Real-time plot shows clean exponential rise. NTC stays flat below 35 cycles. Melt curve has a single peak per primer pair.

steps.title: Analyze Ct values
steps.instructionMd: Compute ΔΔCt vs your reference gene + sample. Standard rule: Ct difference of 1 ≈ 2× expression difference. Triplicate variance > 0.5 Ct = exclude or re-run.
steps.verificationMd: Triplicate Cts within 0.5 of each other. Reference gene Ct stable across conditions (within 1 Ct).
